panels.general_description: Axial chest CT in lung window with a smooth-margined dark region in the posterior lung on the right side of the image and patchy opacity beside it.
panels.detailed_description: Grayscale axial chest CT image in a lung window with a circled white letter B at the lower right. The cross-section shows the chest wall, a large bright central mediastinal and cardiac region, and two lungs. The lung on the left side of the image contains scattered small bright vessels and a rounded, well-defined bright oval focus of soft-tissue brightness near the mediastinum. The lung on the right side of the image has a smooth-margined, uniformly dark rounded region in its posterior part with a nearly flat upper margin and a curved lower margin; anterior and lateral to it the lung shows heterogeneous patchy brighter opacity. Faint dotted circular lines and curved table lines at the bottom are image-acquisition artefacts of the scanner field and couch. No laterality marker, arrows or measurements are visible.
